meta.titleGames3d: Free 3D games online — chess, pinball, pool, darts, driving — cv.cm
meta.descGames3d: Play free 3D games in your browser with no download: 3D chess, pinball, pool, billiards, snooker, air hockey, darts, a magic cube and solver, a stack game, a driving game and a flight simulator. Works on phones too.

g3d.title: Free 3D games
g3d.lead: 3D browser games that play right here: chess on a 3D board, pinball, 8-ball pool, a billiards trainer (9-ball, Chinese 8-ball, pyramid, three-cushion), snooker, air hockey, darts, a magic cube with a solver, a stack game, a driving and drift game and a flight simulator. Free, nothing to install; the 3D part loads only when you press Play.

faq.a1: Yes. They are free to play with no sign-up and no download. Best scores and times stay in this browser.
faq.q2: Do they work on a phone?
faq.a2: Yes. Each game has touch controls, and the 3D view runs at a lower resolution on phones so it stays smooth. Full screen gives you the most room.
faq.q3: Why does nothing load until I press Play?
faq.a3: The 3D engine (three.js) and the graphics context start only when you play, so the page opens fast and your phone does not spend memory on a game you are only reading about.
faq.q4: The game says 3D is not available. What can I do?
faq.a4: The games need WebGL. Update the browser, turn on hardware acceleration in its settings, or try another browser. Some work or school computers block WebGL.

ui.noWebgl: 3D graphics (WebGL) are not available in this browser. Turn on hardware acceleration or try another browser.
ui.lost: The 3D view stopped (the graphics card was reset). Start again to keep playing.
